page.content:
Bankside polygonal playhouse the Chamberlain's Men built in 1599.

How Globe Theatre connects

  • Faction: Lord Chamberlain's Men — The Lord Chamberlain's Men built and played the Globe.
  • Topic: Shakespeare — The Globe is the Bankside house most tied to Shakespeare's working life.
  • Work: Hamlet — Hamlet was staged at the Globe by Shakespeare's company.
  • Work: Henry V — Henry V's Chorus asks the Globe's yard to stand for Agincourt.

What is Globe Theatre?

The Globe Theatre was the open-air house the Lord Chamberlain's Men raised on Bankside from the timbers of the Theatre, the stage of Hamlet, Henry V, and much of Shakespeare's mature work.

Key threads lead to Lord Chamberlain's Men, Shakespeare, Hamlet and Henry V.
